2609.35381.title: MCP Error Messages Written for Developers Hurt the Most Capable Agents Most
2609.35381.paper_summary: Many Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers wrap web APIs built for human developers, and their error messages tell the reader to run a command, edit a configuration, open a web page or wait. Many agents that read them can only call the server's tools. In 150 widely used MCP servers, 949 of 3,001 error messages tell the caller what to do next, and half of these steps depend on something the server cannot see about the caller. On credential errors, 62 of 67 steps ask for a terminal command, a configuration change or a web page; on rate limits, 20 of 30 say to wait and retry without naming the call to repeat. We tested five OpenAI models that act only through the tools of Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard tasks, and the agents did what the step said. On expired credentials, a terminal command in the step left 45% of tasks recovered, and the loss it caused grew from 18 points for GPT-5.5 to 69 for GPT-6 Astra. On a rate limit, GitHub's "Wait before retrying." left 6%. We tested two remedies. For MCP developers, naming a server tool in the step raised recovery on expired credentials to 84%, with the login tool in place of the command, and on a rate limit to 88%, with the call to repeat in place of the bare wait. For agent developers, deleting the step with a one-sentence prompt before the model reads it raised recovery on expired credentials to 82%.
2609.35381.paper_summary_zh: 許多模型上下文協議（MCP）伺服器包裝了為人類開發者構建的網頁 API，它們的錯誤訊息告訴讀者執行命令、編輯配置、打開網頁或等待。許多讀取這些訊息的代理僅能調用伺服器的工具。在 150 個廣泛使用的 MCP 伺服器中，3,001 條錯誤訊息中有 949 條告訴呼叫者接下來該做什麼，而這些步驟中的一半依賴於伺服器無法看到的呼叫者信息。在憑證錯誤中，67 條步驟中有 62 條要求執行終端命令、進行配置更改或打開網頁；在速率限制中，30 條中有 20 條說要等待並重試，但沒有提及要重複的呼叫。我們測試了五個僅通過伯克利函數調用排行榜任務工具運作的 OpenAI 模型，這些代理按照步驟所說的執行。在憑證過期的情況下，步驟中的終端命令使 45% 的任務恢復，而它造成的損失從 GPT-5.5 的 18 分增長到 GPT-6 Astra 的 69 分。在速率限制中，GitHub 的「在重試之前等待。」留下了 6%。我們測試了兩種補救措施。對於 MCP 開發者，在步驟中命名伺服器工具使憑證過期的恢復率提高到 84%，用登錄工具替代命令，對於速率限制則提高到 88%，用重複呼叫替代單純的等待。對於代理開發者，在模型讀取之前刪除步驟並用一句話提示，使憑證過期的恢復率提高到 82%。
2609.35381.author: Xiaonan Xu et.al.
